name: @daoships/sdk
description: Typed DAOShips protocol SDK for applications, services and agents

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build && node scripts/local-contract-smoke.cjs && node scripts/local-navigators-smoke.cjs && node scripts/local-deployment-workflow.cjs
scripts.sync:source: node scripts/sync-abis.mjs && node scripts/generate-contract-types.mjs && node scripts/sync-navigators.mjs
scripts.check:source: npm run build && node scripts/check-source.mjs && node scripts/generate-contract-types.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-navigators.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-app-navigators.mjs --check && node scripts/check-feature-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-indexer-schema.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=dist/*.js --test-coverage-exclude=dist/abis.js --test-coverage-exclude=dist/navigator-bytecodes.js --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=95 scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:package
scripts.validate:workspace: npm run validate && npm run check:source && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:adapters
